status_note: PROPOSED starter catalogue. Imported as DRAFT rules; a clinical domain owner must review each rule, set the owner, and activate it. Only ACTIVE rules are enforced.

definition.explanation: A patient's date of birth is not in the future and implies an age of 0-120 years.
definition.rationale: Biological limit; no verified human has exceeded ~122 years.

rules.name: Patient gender uses the source code set

definition.explanation: Gender is one of the codes used by the source system (M, F, X).
definition.rationale: Observed code set in the source; confirm against the system's data dictionary.

rules.name: Blood group is an ABO/Rh group

definition.explanation: Blood group is one of the eight ABO/Rh(D) groups.
definition.rationale: ABO and Rh(D) typing yields exactly these eight groups.

rules.name: Appointment status uses the source code set

definition.explanation: Appointment status is SCHEDULED, COMPLETED or CANCELLED.
definition.rationale: Observed code set in the source system.

rules.name: Appointment is not before the patient's birth

definition.explanation: A patient cannot attend an appointment before they were born.
definition.rationale: Event chronology. Evaluated only when patients are generated with appointments.

definition.explanation: Diagnosis codes follow the ICD-10 category/subcategory shape (e.g. E11.9, I10).
definition.rationale: ICD-10 code structure: letter, two characters, optional dot and up to 4 more. Shape only, not code validity.

rules.name: Claim amount is positive and bounded

definition.explanation: A claim amount is positive and at most 1,000,000.
definition.rationale: Source maximum is ~124,000; upper bound is a generous placeholder for the domain owner to set.

rules.name: Claim is filed on/after its appointment, within a year

definition.explanation: Claims are usually filed after the appointment they bill for, within 365 days.
definition.rationale: Billing chronology. Soft because the SOURCE data itself has claims dated before their appointment (pre-authorisation?) - domain owner to decide.

rules.name: Obstetric diagnoses are recorded for female patients

definition.explanation: ICD-10 chapter O (pregnancy, childbirth) codes apply to female patients.
definition.rationale: ICD-10 chapter XV. Soft: gender identity vs. sex at birth and the 'X' code need clinical policy. Not evaluable on this schema until diagnosis and gender share a row.
